content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for PGIMER Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 12-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for PGIMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the PGIMER Research Scientist and Helping Attendant posts is 12 September 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications are submitted via email before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in PGIMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced in the PGIMER Recruitment 2026. These vacancies are for the posts of Research Scientist and Helping Attendant, with one post for each.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for PGIMER Various Posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for PGIMER Various Posts Recruitment 2026 is Email. Interested candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for Research Scientist post?
faq.answer: For the Research Scientist post, candidates must possess an M.Sc. in a relevant discipline with 2 years of experience in Microbiology. This is a key eligibility criterion for the role.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Helping Attendant post at PGIMER?
faq.answer: The salary for the Helping Attendant post at PGIMER is Rs. 18,000/- per month. This is a contractual position with a fixed monthly remuneration as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for PGIMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for PGIMER Recruitment 2026 for any category, including General/OBC and SC/ST candidates. Applicants can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for PGIMER Various Posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for PGIMER Various Posts includes two main stages: Shortlisting of applications, followed by a Final Test. Candidates will be selected based on their performance in these stages.

faq.answer: The job location for these PGIMER posts is Chandigarh, Chandigarh, with the pincode 160012. This indicates that selected candidates will be working within the PGIMER campus in Chandigarh.

faq.answer: The advertisement number for this PGIMER recruitment is MC001563. Candidates should refer to this number when corresponding or seeking information about the notification.

faq.answer: The Final Test for PGIMER Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 17 September 2026. Candidates who are shortlisted will be notified about the exact details and venue for the test.
